Batchline v2 · API key · MDM

Set Base URL to the deployment root (including its optional path prefix). Set connection_params to {"api_key": "YOUR_KEY", "timezone": "Europe/Madrid"}. SSL verification is enabled. No token is requested; every call sends X-API-KEY.

Import elements creates an inventory attachment. Configure existing devices with {"device_id": "IDENTIFIER", "start_date": "2026-01-01"} and sensors with {"tag": "EXACT_TAG_NAME"}. Optional sensor start_date overrides the device. Daily Sync resumes on the last stored reading's local day, inclusively; otherwise it uses the configured start date or January 1. Computed sensors run separately.

Supported GET endpoints: /api/alta/elementos and /api/alta/elementos/historico (inicio, fin, elemento, tag). Responses use identificador/descripcion/tags and fecha/valor, not the old PascalCase keys.

Offsets and fractional seconds are supported. Naive times use the configured timezone; ambiguous/nonexistent DST times are rejected. Reading failures are isolated. Normal runs commit every 1000 attempts and at sensor end; dry-run tests do not commit. Imports retain JSON audit attachments and progress logs.

Dedicated pressure routes are not documented in the supplied Swagger. Legacy pressure procedures are inactive and explicitly blocked. Pressure tags published as elements use the normal device_id/tag workflow. No legacy pressure mapping is guessed. Low-network meters are excluded. No cron is enabled.
